title: Albumblätter - No. 10
notable_excerpt: Key: E-flat major. Chord journey: bVII - IV - ii65 - V7 - I42 - IV6 - ii - iii - VI - vi - iii - viio43 - VI - i - v - IV6 - ii - I - IV, sequential chromatic drift back toward I. Texture: chordal accompaniment with a singing upper line and a sustained bass.
